craft_notes: Sthāyin: fruit — triple grant. Rows: grant then goal. Read aloud: full measure.

lines: The goddess-wheel grows full, granting powers, wisdom, release.
Keep stillness, and reach still Śiva — here the goddess-wheel.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tṛptaṃ devīcakraṃ siddhijñānāpavargadaṃ bhavati śāntābhyāse śāntaṃ śivam eti yad atra devatācakram
